þē: þe — which, that (relative particle; Klaeber prints þē, emended — the MS has only 'þ') · þū — you (dative singular: to you, with you) · þū — you (accusative singular; þæt ic þē sōhte 'that I should seek you') · sē — the, by that (instrumental singular of the demonstrative, before a comparative; þē geornor 'the more clearly') · þū — you, yourself (reflexive dative; þū þē self 'you yourself') · þe — when, after (relative particle, if þē is taken as the sense of the clause requires; þē se āglǣca ... gewand 'when the awesome one ... turned', where several editors print þā; a guess) · þe — because (conjunction, the relative particle; þē hē ūsic gārwīgend gōde tealde 'because he counted us good spear-warriors')
þēoden: þēoden — lord, chief of a people (accusative singular; from þēod 'people') · þēoden — lord (vocative singular) · þēoden — lord, prince (masculine, nominative singular)
þēodne: þēoden — lord, prince (dative singular; from þēod 'people')
þǣr: þǣr — there (adverb) · þǣr — where (relative adverb; þǣr ic fīfe geband 'where I bound five') · þǣr — if, provided that (conjunction; þǣr hē meahte swā 'if he could so')
ābroten: ābrēotan — destroyed, killed (past participle, strong verb II; Kemble's emendation of the manuscript's abreoten; with hæfde)
ālǣtan: ālǣtan — leave, give up, let go (infinitive, strong verb VII; ā- + lǣtan 'let')
ǣnig: ǣnig — any (adjective, nominative singular masculine; cf. 'any')
ǣr: ǣr — before, previously (adverb; cf. archaic 'ere') · ǣr — before (conjunction; ǣr gē 'before you') · ǣr — sooner, earlier (adverb, with a comparative sense; nō þȳ ǣr 'none the sooner') · ǣr — before (preposition with dative; ǣr dēaþe 'before death')
